key_insight: Boltz-Flow improves robot action generation by replacing fixed Gaussian initialization with an observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base vision-language-action policy unchanged.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets richer, coordinated action initialization without redesigning the underlying flow-matching policy.
method: Use a conditional Boltzmann machine to assign energies to binary source states.
Train with an offline-demonstration-based listwise objective that aligns energy with action quality after frozen flow integration.
Solve the resulting Ising instance, decode its solution into continuous noise, and perform one standard flow integration.
evidence_signal: Across three benchmarks, Boltz-Flow improves π₀.₅, outperforms compared policy baselines and noise-optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, and ranks second to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus.
watch_item: Training uses a physical coherent Ising machine; hardware accessibility and Ising-solver latency warrant assessment before deployment.
paper_title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
